scope: Generated PDF layout metadata; no files, API or browser profile accessed.

results.name: Explicit separated legends map a complete ordered run to named figures while excluding legends-only pages
Missing or extra figure pages do not cause guessed identifiers
A body reference without an explicit legend heading cannot name anonymous graphics
Gaps and prose pages prevent ambiguous legend ordering
Journal banners and isolated small graphics are excluded from detached figure candidates
Vector-only figure pages qualify alongside raster figures without extracting decorative paths
Already associated inline figures prevent a second detached mapping of the same identities
